summary: Alchemy Investments Acquisition Corp 1, a Nasdaq-listed SPAC (Special Purpose Acquisition Company) incorporated in the Cayman Islands, filed an 8-K disclosing a potential business combination with Cartiga, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company. The filing includes an investor presentation dated April 2026 and references upcoming proxy materials to be filed with the SEC, including a Registration Statement on Form S-4.
